title: Scorecard
intro: Every signal publishes a price band with 80% confidence. This table shows how often the real price actually landed inside that band — the only honest test of whether the confidence numbers mean anything.
no_data: No matured forecasts to score yet.
verdict_calibrated: Bands are well calibrated: {rate}% hit rate against a {target}% target (over {checked} forecasts).
verdict_too_narrow: Bands are too narrow: {rate}% hit rate is below the {target}% target (over {checked} forecasts). The system is more confident than it should be.
verdict_too_wide: Bands are too wide: {rate}% hit rate exceeds the {target}% target (over {checked} forecasts). Correct, but too vague to trade.
verdict_insufficient_data: Not enough samples ({checked} forecasts). At least 20 are needed for a statistical verdict.
pending_note: {pending} horizons have not matured yet and were not counted.
